messages:
maria_cs: Quick async standup re: Polaris Data onboarding — they hit an adoption blocker after yesterday's SDK update. TL;DR: some webhook deliveries are 500ing and the customer is asking for a timeline.

maria_cs: What I did — traced errors to our webhook worker queuing spike, escalated to infra, opened a support ticket with Polaris support lead.

maria_cs: Blockers — need a rollback or hotfix deploy, and an answer on whether we can enable a temporary webhook retry/backoff for them. Also they asked about data deletion for one test tenant (GDPR ask).

aj_dev: On the rollback/hotfix: I can revert the SDK change (PR #421) and cut a patch today. PR is small, just a header encoding fix. Pushing a revert now — will need a quick review. @kevin_se can you greenlight the revert? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam_eng: I dug into the worker logs, looks like a rare concurrency bug when payloads > 8KB. Example trace:

```
ERROR webhook/worker:panic at write -> broken pipe
stack: github.com/redwood/infer/webhook.Write(0xc000...)\nat runtime.go:123
```

sam_eng: I can add a mitigation to cap payload size + better error handling but that'll be a minor patch, not urgent if we roll back.

kevin_se: Revert is fine for now, customer SLA is higher priority. Approving revert PR, please include a note in the release changelog about the encoding fix so we can reintroduce safely. Also we should offer Polaris a short maintenance window and status update.

liam_support: Polaris is waiting on an ETA. They specifically asked for: 1) ETA to resolution, 2) confirmation that data for tenant td-9876 can be deleted, 3) whether this will affect their dedicated capacity. I told them we'd update in 2 hours.

maria_cs: Action list — @aj_dev revert PR and ping when merged; @sam_eng prepare a follow-up patch with payload cap; @kevin_se draft the maintenance note + approve messaging for Polaris; @liam_support hold the deletion confirmation until legal signs off (I'll loop in legal). I'll post the customer-facing update once we have the revert merged.

aj_dev: Revert PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infer/pulls/427 — small patch, added a test. I'm running CI now.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Revert PR 427 merged to staging by aj_dev at 1971114500. CI: passed, deploying to canary.

sam_eng: Canary logs look healthy so far. No 500s in the last 10m.

liam_support: Sent interim update to Polaris: "We've identified a regression in the SDK; we're rolling back to a safe build and expect no customer impact after the canary completes. ETA ~30–60m." They replied :thumbsup:.

maria_cs: Blocker update: waiting on canary -> full rollback. If successful, we offer Polaris a free support block and follow-up postmortem. Also still need legal OK on tenant deletion.

kevin_se: If rollback succeeds, add a monitoring alert to catch payload >8KB events for next 48h. Also schedule a quick postmortem with eng + cs tomorrow.

aj_dev: Canary succeeded, starting rollback to prod now. Will post final when done.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback deployment started at 1971118123 by aj_dev; progress 0/3 regions.

aj_dev: Rollback completed in all regions at 1971118900. No further 500s observed in canary or prod logs.

maria_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll send the official update to Polaris (incl. offer + PM invite). Follow-ups: sam to open payload-cap PR, kevin to add alert, liam to coordinate deletion with legal.

liam_support: Noted — will loop in legal and update here.

sam_eng: I'll open the patch and reference this thread. ETA EOD for the mitigation PR.

kevin_se: Adding PM invite for postmortem at 10am UTC tomorrow.

maria_cs: Great. Close loop once deletion is confirmed. Thanks all :heart:
